page.description: Rockstor editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An open-source NAS and BTRFS storage platform built on OpenSUSE Leap. Provides a web-based management interface for file sharing, snapshots, and pool management.
pros: Built-in BTRFS snapshot and rollback capabilities
Multi-architecture support including ARM64 and Raspberry Pi
cons: Built on OpenSUSE which has a smaller desktop ecosystem
Stable release channel lags behind testing/edge by months
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Rockstor; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO to a USB stick with dd. Boot from the USB and follow the installer. The system installs to the target disk and provides a web management UI at http://<server-ip>:8181.
